MR-I READYEPILEPSY

Set the head up in the head coil, run the 3-plane localiser, plan the sagittal T1 — then angle the axial along the hippocampus and the coronal straight across it, the way an epilepsy protocol demands
Demonstration only — an educational simulation of MRI planning, not a medical device, not for clinical use. Every diagnostic image is reformatted from one real 3 T MRI of a patient with surgically proven hippocampal sclerosis (public-domain research data), shown with its true geometry; the localiser is rebuilt from the same scan — see the credits on the results screen.
